study: O'Hare et al. 2019, FFT Literacy Reciprocal Reading (EEF evaluation report)
delivery_evidence: Teacher training by FFT Literacy was face-to-face: two external full-day off-site training sessions plus three internal half-day in-school follow-up sessions over 16 weeks (Intervention / Materials section; 'two external full-day training sessions and three internal half-day follow-up sessions'); no online PD component reported.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is the New Group Reading Test (NGRT), a nationally standardised, independently published adaptive commercial test (GL Assessment) not tailored to the intervention (Outcomes; Table 13, p.38).
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting the Reciprocal Reading programme; after training teachers were provided a core materials package (teacher manual, pupil books, journal activities, reading books) to deliver it (Intervention / Materials section).
outcome_timing_evidence: NGRT measured at post-test after ~1 academic year of intervention, same year (primary analysis, Table 13, p.38).
